comparison.objective: Keep a machine loader supplied with one blank per cycle.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed pick-and-place into a locating nest while avoiding a moving arm.
comparison.success_condition: Five blanks individually seated, collected by the loader and delivered to the chute; collisions or double-loading fail.
comparison.reason: Tests temporal replenishment and collision avoidance, not manipulation of a mixed batch or physical classification.
